from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from enum import StrEnum
from functools import cached_property
from typing import ClassVar, NamedTuple, Protocol, TypedDict

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field


class LeadStatus(StrEnum):
    """TODO: summary.

    Attributes:
        NEW: TODO: description.
        TAKEN: TODO: description.
        CLOSED: TODO: description.
    """

    NEW = "new"
    TAKEN = "taken"
    CLOSED = "closed"


class Lead:
    """TODO: summary.

    Args:
        lead_id (int): TODO: description.
        source (str): TODO: description.
        phone (str | None): TODO: description. Defaults to `None`.

    Attributes:
        MAX_CALL_ATTEMPTS (ClassVar[int]): TODO: description.
        source (str): TODO: description.
        phone (str | None): TODO: description. Defaults to `None`.
        normalize (Callable[[str], str]): TODO: description.
        id (int): TODO: description. Read-only.
        status (LeadStatus): TODO: description.
    """

    MAX_CALL_ATTEMPTS: ClassVar[int] = 3
    source: str
    phone: str | None = None
    normalize: Callable[[str], str] = staticmethod(lambda raw: raw.strip().lower())
    _id: int
    __slots_hint__ = "dunder: skipped"

    def __init__(self, lead_id: int, source: str, *, phone: str | None = None) -> None:
        self._id = lead_id
        self.source = source
        self.phone = phone
        self.created_at = datetime.now().astimezone()
        self._status = LeadStatus.NEW

    @property
    def id(self) -> int:
        return self._id

    @property
    def status(self) -> LeadStatus:
        return self._status

    @status.setter
    def status(self, value: LeadStatus) -> None:
        self._status = value

    @status.deleter
    def status(self) -> None:
        self._status = LeadStatus.NEW

    @cached_property
    def masked_phone(self) -> str:
        """TODO: summary."""
        return (self.phone or "")[-4:].rjust(10, "*")

    @property
    def _internal(self) -> int:
        return self._id


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Slot:
    """TODO: summary.

    Attributes:
        starts_at (datetime): TODO: description.
        length (timedelta): TODO: description.
        tags (list[str]): TODO: description.
        priority (int): TODO: description. Defaults to `0`.
    """

    starts_at: datetime
    length: timedelta = timedelta(minutes=15)
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    priority: int = 0


class LeadIn(BaseModel):
    """TODO: summary.

    \f

    Attributes:
        model_config: Pydantic model configuration.
        name (str): TODO: description.
        phone (str): TODO: description.
        comment (str | None): TODO: description. Defaults to `None`.
    """

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    phone: str
    comment: str | None = None


class Point(NamedTuple):
    """TODO: summary.

    Attributes:
        lat (float): TODO: description.
        lon (float): TODO: description. Defaults to `0.0`.
    """

    lat: float
    lon: float = 0.0


class WebhookPayload(TypedDict):
    """TODO: summary.

    Attributes:
        form_id (str): TODO: description.
        fields (dict[str, str]): TODO: description.
    """

    form_id: str
    fields: dict[str, str]


class Notifier(Protocol):
    """TODO: summary.

    Attributes:
        channel (str): TODO: description.
        enabled (bool): TODO: description. Read-only.
    """

    channel: str

    @property
    def enabled(self) -> bool: ...
